speaker: Doctor
text: The timeline of your symptoms is concerning; you have urinary incontinence for a year, followed by walking difficulties for three months, and recent speech issues. speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive difficulty walking. I also have Urinary incontinence, Slurred speech, Rigidity in limbs, Mild hand tremor, Orthostatic hypotension.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (MSA-C).

Your symptoms of progressive gait disturbance, autonomic dysfunction (orthostatic hypotension, urinary incontinence), cerebellar signs (slurred speech, tremor), and rigidity are classic for MSA-C. I am requesting imaging of the brain to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with focus on putamen atrophy and cerebellar atrophy.
